thread:
alex: Quick sanity check before we kick off the catalog rollout for `ursa-lite-4k-v2` — weights are at `s3://redwood-models/ursa/4k/v2/weights.pt`. Tokenizer seems to split BOS differently vs our standard; noticed extra <s> token in a few prompts. Can infra/runtime confirm: 1) weight manifest path ok? 2) tokenizer mapping we should patch? 3) any special runtime flags needed for KV cache/quant?

jia: I pulled the weights path, exists and checksum matches the manifest: `sha256:fa1b...c3`. Good to go on storage.

sam: Re: tokenizer — looks like SentencePiece model has an extra bos_id=1 that our tokenizer-wrapper isn't stripping. Small fix in the tokenizer adapter will do. I'll open a tiny PR.

alex: PR? link please. Also planning to pin catalog entry to `ursa-lite-4k@v2.1` and canary to us-west-2 single pod for 10% traffic. Need runtime + infra signoff for canary policy and fallback variant: `ursa-lite-2b-quant`.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/342 — adapter change + unit test. Should be non-breaking.

nate: Runtime notes: for 4k context we need to set `kv_cache_shard_size: 256MB` in serving config, otherwise memory blowups during the warmup batch. Also the quantized fallback requires `allow_mixed_precision: true` to avoid kernel mismatch on A100s. I'll attach the config snippet.

megan: QA checklist: will run the short prompt set and evals -> perf + quality baselines. ETA 6 hours after PR merges.

lucy: Ops question — can we enable EU central (eu-central-1) in the same rollout window or do we want to stagger? EU needs the customer keyring added to KMS and a manifest entry pointing to the eu mirror.

alex: Plan: canary in us-west-2 now. If metrics stable after 2 hours, expand to eu-central with the mirror + KMS step. If any quality regression > 1.5% on evals, rollback to `ursa-lite-4k@v2.0`.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: `catalog-canary-create` by @alex — job id `job_20260317_98`.

deploy-bot: canary instance spun in us-west-2, pod `ursa-lite-4k-canary-7f8d`. Health checks passing (3/3).

sam: Noted — tokenizer PR merged and released in models repo. Also added a mapping shim for older saved tokenizers.

nate: Added the `kv_cache_shard_size: 256MB` and `allow_mixed_precision: true` flags to the serving config in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-configs/pull/158. Also added a runtime validation rule that fails deploys if `context_length` > `model_max_context` in the manifest.

megan: Ran the short eval suite against the canary: quality delta +0.1%, latency p50 +12ms, p95 +80ms, error rate 0.1%. No obvious regressions.

lucy: EU prep: I uploaded the eu mirror manifest to `s3://eu-redwood-models/ursa/4k/v2/weights.pt` and created KMS grant `kms-grant-ursa-v2-eu`. Need someone on infra to add the grant to the catalog entry.

alex: Sounds good. Action items: sam (tokenizer adapter ✅), nate (serving flags + validation ✅), lucy (eu mirror + KMS ✅), megan (QA pass ✅). I'll promote to staged rollout after 2h stable metrics. If anyone sees anything odd, ping here or @oncall. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: `job_20260317_98` completed: catalog canary created, traffic routed 10% us-west-2 -> pod `ursa-lite-4k-canary-7f8d`.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics alerting configured: latency/p95, error-rate, eval-quality. Thresholds: p95 > 200ms OR error-rate > 0.5% OR quality delta < -1.5% triggers automatic rollback.

alex: One more check — is fallback variant auto-failover tested? who's owner for that policy?

nate: I ran a simulated capacity drop and verified fallback to `ursa-lite-2b-quant` works end-to-end (streaming preserved, tokens aligned). Left a short runbook at `/runbooks/model-fallbacks/ursa-lite.md`.

sam: Also added a tiny prompt normalization step to handle the extra <s> token — less likely to affect logs/metrics.

megan: I'll schedule a longer overnight run against the canary for broader prompt types. Will report AM.

alex: Thanks all. Closing out here — will post rollout expansion when I promote to eu.

megan: (left a comment) noted a small spike in memory during long conversations, looks within expected but will keep monitoring.

alex: good catch — nate can you add a dashboard widget for `kv_cache_memory` per pod so we can watch during expansion?

nate: on it, ETA 20m.

deploy-bot: note: manual approval required for eu expansion.

alex: approving now. :rocket:
